label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I ii… supports A move that affirms that God can be known…
note: Common principles of reason are equally known to all, which supports a standard of reason shared with outsiders. Gap: the article does not classify God's existence; if it is a proper conclusion (an additional interpretive premise, not stated here, for which ST I q.2 a.1 would be the place to look), the passage gives that it is true for all but not that it is equally known to all.
